samples.summary: Design-sandbox workspace-settings fixture not updated for the new API-keys shape; its doc comment is now wrong. `FIXTURE_API_KEYS` has no `createdBy` (nor `scopes`), and the sandbox seeds `FIXTURE_USER` as `owner`, so the new owner-only "Created by" column that this PR adds renders "Unknown" for every row in the repo's own design-review surface. The file header (lines 5-6) also still describes "API Keys" as an owner-gated section, which this PR deliberately changed — the section now renders for every member. The PR touched the frontend page, its API types and its tests but left the fixture that exists to let designers judge this exact page, so the sandbox now shows a state the product can never produce. Cost stays inside the codebase (design review fidelity), hence minor.
samples.evidence: packages/design-sandbox/src/scenes/fixtures/workspace.ts:42-50 defines keys with only id/name/prefix/createdAt/lastUsedAt, while packages/frontend/src/api/workspaces.ts:164-178 now requires `createdBy` and workspace-settings.tsx:460-477 renders `creatorName(apiKey.createdBy)` for owners; the same file's header comment lines 5-6 calls API Keys an "owner-gated" section.

samples.summary: "Created by" is resolved client-side by joining `ApiKey.createdBy` against `workspace.members`, so a key minted by a member who has since left the workspace displays "Unknown" to the owner. The documented behaviour is that an owner sees every key in the workspace "with an extra Created by column naming each key's minter" (packages/documentation/guide/workspaces.md:95-98), and the backend list is filtered only by `workspaceId`/`revokedAt` (api-key.service.ts:55-74) — it deliberately keeps ex-members' keys in the listing. Resolving the minter in the client from a different collection is the wrong layer for this: the server, which already has the `createdBy` FK, is the only place that can name a user who is no longer in `members`. Behaviour still matches the spec for current members, so the cost is confined to a degraded owner view in exactly the case the column exists for.
samples.evidence: workspace-settings.tsx:152-155 `creatorName` falls back to "Unknown"; api-key.service.ts:55-74 returns `createdBy` only, with no membership filter.

finding.summary: Shipped user guide still documents API keys as owner-only and describes the now-removed UI gate
finding.evidence: The change opens minting/listing/revoking to any member and removes the `isOwner` gate on the Settings API Keys section, and it updated docs/design/*.md and packages/backend/README.md. But the end-user documentation package was missed: `guide/workspaces.md:42-43` still says "Create or revoke an API key | No | Yes" and "See the list of API keys | Yes, but only via the CLI or REST API"; line 87 lists "**API Keys** — *owners only*"; line 90 says "A member sees the first three sections and nothing below them"; and the tip at lines 92-97 states "creating and revoking are owner-only. The Settings page … hides the whole **API Keys** section from anyone who isn't an owner … There is nothing to find in Settings." All of these are now false, and this is the page members actually read to learn whether they can mint a key.

verdict.reason: The quoted stale documentation does not exist in the repository. packages/documentation/guide/workspaces.md (the only file at that path) already reflects the member-accessible API key behavior: lines 42-44 read "See the list of API keys | Only the ones you created | Yes, every member's", "Create an API key | Yes | Yes", "Revoke an API key | Only ones you created | Yes" — not "Create or revoke an API key | No | Yes". Line 88 reads "**API Keys** — everyone, scoped to what you may see" (the "*owners only*" tags on lines 87 and 89 are for Invites and Danger Zone). Line 91 reads "A member sees every section except **Invites** and **Danger Zone**", not "the first three sections and nothing below them". The tip at lines 93-100 describes the new per-role scoping (members see/revoke their own keys and can create more; owners see all with a Created by column, same scoping in CLI and REST). This matches the implementation in workspace-settings.tsx:432-452, where the API Keys section and Create API Key button render with no isOwner gate, isOwner only varying the description copy (439-441) and the Created by column (460, 473), while Invites (356) and Danger Zone (508-509) remain owner-gated as the doc says.
